decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording that an existing non-Webflow host is connected to the root domain, while its prior state already requires continued routing to the customer-facing product.
Preserving the root domain's existing product host does not change the selected Basic Webflow plan or the cost-selection rule for the marketing site.
The root-domain hosting constraint does not alter the format or purpose of the site-editing instruction recording.
The existing product host does not change the requirement to transfer the Webflow website into the client's workspace.
The domain-routing constraint does not change the landing page's content composition or screenshot-selection policy.
The reference to the existing product host concerns DNS and hosting, not the hero section's product visualization.
Preserving root-domain product hosting does not change the dealer-login button's placement or destination URL.
The custom-domain routing constraint does not change navigation from the early-access call to action to the contact page.
The existing root-domain host does not alter contact-form submission delivery or recipient addresses.
The DNS and hosting constraint does not affect the landing page's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
